summary.text: Victor L. Scoggin of Pegram, an independent who qualified by petition, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Tennessee to Marsha Blackburn, with less than 0.1% of the vote to her 45.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
His campaign site described him as a Navy veteran, retired volunteer firefighter and farmer and founder of Save the Cumberland Inc.
